title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: Requesting a Refund for a Missed or Cancelled Event
content:
If a user asks about a refund:

- If the event was cancelled or rescheduled by the venue, the user is automatically issued a credit or refund within 5-7 business days
- If the user simply missed their reservation, no refund is owed under standard policy
- Exceptions (medical emergency, transit strike, etc.) can be escalated to the support lead for manual review
- Do NOT promise a refund before checking the reservation status in the app

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If your event was cancelled by the venue, you'll automatically receive a credit or refund within 5-7 business days. If you missed a reservation, refunds aren't guaranteed, but I can escalate your case if there were extenuating circumstances."

title: How to Update Payment Method or Billing Information
content:
Users can manage billing details via the app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'.

- Add a new card: tap 'Add Payment Method' and follow the prompts
- Remove or replace a card: tap the existing card, then 'Edit' or 'Remove'
- If a payment fails, the user has a 7-day grace period before the subscription is paused
- Billing address must match the card issuer's records to avoid declines

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment method under 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods' in the CultPass app. If a recent payment failed, you have 7 days to update your card before your subscription is paused."

title: Can I Bring a Guest? Using Guest Passes
content:
Guest pass availability depends on the user's subscription tier:

- Basic: no guest passes included
- Plus: 1 guest pass per month
- Premium: 3 guest passes per month
- Redeem a guest pass from the event detail screen by tapping 'Bring a Guest' before reserving
- Unused guest passes do not roll over to the next month

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Guest passes depend on your plan - Plus members get 1 per month and Premium members get 3. You can redeem one from the event page by tapping 'Bring a Guest' before you reserve, but they don't roll over month to month."

title: Troubleshooting the CultPass App When It Won't Load or Crashes
content:
Walk the user through these steps in order:

1. Check that their device has an active internet connection
2. Confirm the app is updated to the latest version from the App Store / Play Store
3. Force-close and reopen the app
4. Restart the device
5. If the issue persists, clear the app cache (Android) or offload/reinstall the app (iOS)
6. If still unresolved, escalate to technical support with the user's device model and OS version

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Let's try a few quick fixes: make sure the app is updated, then restart your device. If it still won't load, try reinstalling the app. If that doesn't help, I'll pass this along to our technical team with your device details."

title: Accessibility Accommodations at CultPass Events
content:
CultPass partners with venues that support a range of accessibility needs:

- Wheelchair-accessible entry is noted on each event's detail page with a wheelchair icon
- Sign language interpretation or assistive listening devices can be requested at least 5 business days before the event via 'Request Accommodation' on the event page
- Service animals are welcome at all partner venues
- For accommodations not listed, escalate to support so the venue can be contacted directly

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can check accessibility details on each event's page, and request accommodations like interpretation services at least 5 business days in advance using the 'Request Accommodation' option. If you need something specific that isn't listed, I can reach out to the venue for you."

title: How to Upgrade or Downgrade Your Subscription Plan
content:
Plan changes are made via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Upgrades take effect immediately, with a prorated charge for the remainder of the billing cycle
- Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle so no benefits already paid for are lost
- Any unused guest passes or experience credits from the current tier are forfeited on downgrade
- Do NOT process manual proration outside of the app's automatic calculation

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your plan under 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'. Upgrades apply right away with a prorated charge, while downgrades take effect at your next billing date so you keep this cycle's benefits."

title: What to Do If You Forgot Your QR Code at the Venue
content:
Users do not need a printed ticket - the QR code is always available digitally:

- Reopen the CultPass app and go to 'My Reservations' to pull up the QR code again
- If the phone is unavailable, the email confirmation sent at booking also contains a valid QR code
- As a last resort, venue staff can verify identity using the user's full name and a photo ID
- Advise users to have their phone brightness turned up for faster scanning

**Suggested phrasing:**
"No worries - you can always pull up your QR code again under 'My Reservations' in the app, or check the confirmation email. If neither is available, venue staff can verify you with a photo ID."

title: Managing Notifications and Event Reminders
content:
Notification preferences are controlled via the app > 'Settings' > 'Notifications'.

- Push notifications: new experiences added to the catalog, reservation reminders 24 hours before an event
- Email notifications: subscription renewal alerts, receipts, and policy updates
- Users can toggle each category independently or mute all non-essential notifications
- Renewal and billing notifications cannot be fully disabled, only sent via email instead of push

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can fine-tune what you hear from us under 'Settings' > 'Notifications' in the app - separate toggles exist for new experiences, reservation reminders, and billing alerts."

title: How the CultPass Referral Program Works
content:
Every user has a unique referral code found under 'My Account' > 'Rewards'.

- Sharing the code or link gives a new user 20% off their first month
- The referring user receives a credit equal to one free experience once the referred friend completes their first paid month
- Referral rewards are capped at 5 per calendar year per account
- Rewards are credited automatically; no manual claim is required

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can find your referral code under 'My Account' > 'Rewards'. Friends who sign up with it get 20% off their first month, and you'll get a free experience credit once they complete their first paid month."

title: Requesting Account Data Access or Deletion
content:
Users have the right to request a copy of their data or full account deletion:

- Data export requests can be submitted via app > 'My Account' > 'Privacy' > 'Request My Data'
- Account deletion requests must be submitted in writing through the same 'Privacy' section and are processed within 30 days
- Deleting an account cancels any active subscription immediately and forfeits unused credits
- Do NOT delete or export account data manually - always route the request through the official privacy workflow and escalate to the privacy team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can request a copy of your data or ask to delete your account under 'My Account' > 'Privacy'. Deletion requests are processed within 30 days, and please note this will cancel any active subscription right away."
